stay.nearest_base: Mandi town (about 50 km) for hotels; Baggi village for the trailhead
stay.price_basis: Budget = PWD Rest House at the lake, 5 rooms, 1,000 per night for non-Himachalis (500 for Himachalis) booked on Him Atithi, tariff notification dated 4 Feb 2026 (discoverwithdheeraj.com, updated 24 Aug 2026). Forest Rest House about 1,000 plus 12% GST (Vargis Khan). Mid and homestay figures are WEAK: USD 'from' prices in search-result snippets x96.8 (MTFX 8 Oct 2026): Parashar Lake Fogg Hill Resort USD 29.54 and 34.54 (Booking pages), mid 3,101; Himalyan Wild Trails Swiss Camp USD 39.94 = 3,866; homestays: Gazing Moon USD 16.04 = 1,553, Mathan View INR 1,567 (homestays.co.in), Royal Prashar Lake Homestay USD 35 = 3,388, Parasharalya USD 37.51 = 3,631.
stay.notes: Several of those priced homestays are a few km from the lake (Parasharalya 4.1 km). Other private offers seen: tents 500-1,500 per person (Dheeraj, 2026), campsite about 1,000 per person incl meals (Vargis Khan, undated), Universal Adventures camping package 1,999 per person from Baggi (snippet), Fogg Hill camp from 500 per person (June 2024 comment). Temple dormitory: free with donation of 100-200 suggested (Dheeraj 2026), not a hostel. Rest house fills in May, June, Sept, Oct.

point_to_point.route: Mandi to Prashar Lake (sedan, CabBazar)
point_to_point.range: CabBazar 2,300 sedan, 3,300 SUV; guides 1,500-2,500 one-way, 2,000-3,000 round trip; Wikivoyage 1,000-1,500

point_to_point.route: Mandi to Baggi village (taxi)
HRTC bus Mandi to Prashar Lake

taxi_day.basis: There is no local taxi at the lake: a visit is a day trip from Mandi. 2,500 = round-trip taxi from Mandi to the lake road-end (Vargis Khan 'round trip from Mandi ISBT or Kullu 2,500', Dec 2019 reader report; consistent with CabBazar 2,300 one-way sedan and guides' 2,000-3,000 round trip). Last stretch of road is poor; locals use Boleros.
taxi_day.notes: Not a local-sightseeing figure. Vehicle road beyond Baggi is usable roughly April to October; winter snow can cut it.

food_per_person_day.basis: Meals at lake cafes 80-150, tea 30-50 (Dheeraj, updated 14 Aug 2026): 3 meals at about 115 = 350. Camps/packages include meals (campsite about 1,000 per person incl meals). No sit-down restaurants at the lake, so standard is null; Mandi town standard is about 600 per day.
food_per_person_day.notes: Shops near the temple have no listed prices anywhere. PWD rest house offers food on request (price not found).
